shrinkage.heatmap_visual_interpolation: Gouraud color interpolation between saved mesh nodes; no PDE state evaluated or extrapolated.
shrinkage.outside_material: No mesh or fill beyond the current outer vertex R(t); white background.

details.process_sampling: Q3 every stored 60 s plus exact execution output; Q4 all 3067 stored outputs. Rulers read exact saved JSON root and execution metadata.
details.event_scope: Each root/execution result is for its one-dimensional effective model and assumed environment; no continuous 2D or physical execution guarantee.
details.between_question_scope: Q3 uses appendix 3 and fixed radius; Q4 uses appendix 4 and prescribed shrinkage. Difference between these two curves is not a pure shrinkage effect.

old_new_mapping.q3_q4_drying: Retains axis, current surface, threshold and official execution labels; adds stored discrete root-to-execution evidence.
old_new_mapping.q4_shrinkage: Retains all 145 radius observations through 72 h in a small panel and four exact-time current-radius profiles; adds moisture map only through official execution.
